title: CreateCraft Aero SMP
description: A survival and exploration modpack built around Create's mechanical automation and technology progression, complemented by deep magic through Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks and a  rich world generation from Let's Do series.
body: A survival and exploration modpack built around Create's mechanical automation and technology progression, complemented by deep magic through Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks, rich world generation from Biomes O' Plenty, and an expansive food and decoration system through Farmer's Delight and the Let's Do suite. Featuring overhauled mobs, Silent Gear's material-based equipment crafting, naval and aerial travel via Small Ships and Create Aeronautics, and a heavily optimized performance stack, the pack offers a dense and cohesive experience that rewards players who engage with every system.
